current_date: 24 August 2026 (adoption date stated on the City of Lincoln planning page; the PDFs themselves carry no adoption date)
current_evidence: City of Lincoln's planning page (lincoln.gov.uk/planning/planning-applications/3) says updated Central Lincolnshire Local Validation Lists were adopted on 24 August 2026 after the 2026 review and links to the central-lincs.org.uk page, which hosts the 2026 Full, Outline, Householder and Listed Building lists. That central-lincs page still carries older wording saying the proposed lists are 'not adopted', so the adoption status should be confirmed.

issues.detail: Grokbot links the May 2024 North Kesteven-hosted Full Applications list. The Central Lincolnshire lists were reviewed in 2026 (consultation from 11 May, closed 7 June 2026). City of Lincoln says the updated lists were adopted on 24 August 2026, and they are now published at central-lincs.org.uk as 'Full / Outline / Householder Applications Validation List 2026' and 'Listed Building Consent Checklist 2026'. The 2026 Full list adds an explicit Affordable Housing Statement requirement (10+ dwellings, 0.5 ha or more, or 5+ dwellings in designated rural areas of North Kesteven).
issues.evidence: lincoln.gov.uk: 'updated lists were adopted by West Lindsey District Council on 24 August 2026'; 2026 Full list: 'Affordable Housing Statement - CLLP S22'

issues.detail: The List date 2024-05-01 comes only from the upload folder in the URL ('2024-05'), not from the document text. The 2024 PDF states no adoption date. Either way, the list has been superseded by the 2026 lists.
issues.evidence: Date basis: 'url path (upload month)'; the PDF text only cites NPPF (December 2023) and the 2024 BNG regulations.

issues.detail: Grokbot captured almost none of the Category 2 local validation requirements. It missed: Tree Survey and Arboricultural Method Statement (where trees are within or adjacent to the site, S66); Energy Statement and completed Energy Efficiency Checklist (S6-S8); Ecological Impact Assessment (S60); Biodiversity Gain Statement (required even where exempt, S61); BNG metric with condition sheets and post-development habitat map (S61, unless exempt); Drainage Statement (all major proposals, S21); Agricultural Land Classification survey (S14/S67); Green Wedge Assessment (S63); Minerals Assessment (mineral safeguarding areas, LCCMWLP M11); Transport Statement/Assessment and Travel Plan (S47/S49); Aviation/Defence and communications assessment, Shadow Flicker and Glint and Glare assessments (S14/S53, renewables); Agricultural Workers Dwelling justification and rural land-based needs assessment (S5); Affordable Housing / First Homes / Exception Site needs assessment (S4/S22); Custom and Self-build Plot Passports or Design Code (NS24); Health Impact Assessment (S54); Town Centre / Retail Impact / Sequential Assessment; Marketing Report for loss of business, commercial or tourism uses; Alternative Employment Sites Assessment (S28-S34); Demolition Justification Statement (S11); Open Space Assessment/Audit (S51). The 2026 list adds an Affordable Housing Statement.
issues.evidence: Full Applications Validation List, 'Category 2 - Local Validation Requirements' table with CLLP policy references

issues.detail: Fee and process text was captured as requirement content. The 'Submission rules' tab item and the Householder, Full and Outline BNG rows begin 'Correct Planning Fee See current fees at: pdf', which is the fee row run into the BNG row. The CIL rows also run into fee text. The 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)' rows (Householder, Full, Outline, LBC) are a fragment of the national site/block plan drawing description, not a separate local requirement.
issues.evidence: Trigger: 'public highway, visibility splays, landscaping, car parking and open areas around buildings).'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are garbled or cut off text pulled from PDF tables. Householder 'Design and Access Statement' runs into the Site Location Plan row and footnote numbers ('Design and Access Statement Site Location Plan2 1 1 Required for...'). 'Block plan' and 'Floor plans / Elevations' merge several drawing rows and scales into the Heritage Statement text. The Archaeology trigger starts mid-sentence ('an appropriate desk-based assessment...'). The Full 'Structural Survey' trigger is just 'combined with Structural Survey.', which belongs to the Demolition Justification Statement (CLLP S11, which 'can be combined with a Structural Survey'). It is not a standalone requirement.
issues.evidence: Full list: 'Demolition Justification Statement - CLLP S11 (can be combined with a Structural Survey)'

issues.detail: The Reserved matters, s73, Discharge of conditions and other rows say 'No specific local requirements identified ... national requirements only'. Central Lincolnshire publishes lists only for Full, Outline, Householder and LBC, but local requirements (BNG statement, drainage for majors and so on) may still apply to s73/RM submissions. These rows should say 'no type-specific list published', not 'national requirements only'.
issues.evidence: Lists published: Full, Outline, Householder, Listed Building Consent only

issues.detail: Environmental Statement (EIA) and Heritage Statement are recorded as local requirements, but they are national/NPPF requirements (Category 1 or national). They are not part of the Category 2 local list, which is mostly missing from the capture.
issues.evidence: Heritage Statement footnote cites NPPF (December 2023); ES cites the EIA Regulations 2017.

summary: Grokbot used the May 2024 Central Lincolnshire lists, which City of Lincoln says the lists adopted on 24 August 2026 have replaced. Its capture missed nearly all of the roughly 26 Category 2 local requirements and mostly holds national items, fee text and garbled table fragments.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
